_note: AI-era skills: skills that ESCO v1.2.1 (2022, before generative AI) does not have. Curated by the HalaTuju team on 2026-10-30. Every skill has 1-3 public sources; each quote is an exact sentence (or clause) copied from the linked page or PDF, and all 58 quotes were checked on 2026-10-30 by downloading the source (curl, HTML tags stripped, or pdftotext) and matching the quote verbatim after whitespace normalisation. 'locator' gives the PDF page (index unless marked 'printed') or the article. 'fileUrl' is the copy of the PDF we read when the publisher's page only links it via script. Skills we could not source were dropped. aiEra: true (all entries) means our exposure model's score is not meaningful for this skill (it measures how much an LLM speeds a task, so AI-usage skills look 'highly exposed'); the app should show 'AI-era skill: grows with AI' instead. workContext is a short team-written phrase for the existing work the AI skill changes; it is used only as search text to find occupations. The links to ESCO skills and occupations are computed, not curated: see ai_skills_links.json (scripts/link-ai-skills.ts).
